_about: Wives and the house: the people who wait up for you.

scenes.title: The roast went cold
scenes.text: It is past eleven when you come in off the boulevard. The table is set for two. The candles have burned down to the brass. {wife.first} is in the kitchen with her back to you, drying a plate that is already dry. "Your mother called," she says. "Twice."

choices.label: Sit down and eat it cold, with her
choices.hint: It is not about the roast.

opinion.why: Sat down with me, for once

memory.text: he sat with her over a cold supper

choices.result: You ate cold roast and talked about nothing until one in the morning. It was the best night in a month.
choices.failText: She let you eat. She did not sit down.

choices.label: Tell her a man was shot on Atlantic Avenue tonight, and let her wonder
Promise her Sunday, the whole day

scenes.title: Sunday, as promised
scenes.text: Mass at St. Ann's, then the beach at the Crest with the umbrella and the cooler. At two o'clock a boy runs down the sand: {caller.first} is on the telephone at the snack stand. He says it cannot wait.

choices.label: Tell the boy you were not here

opinion.why: Broke his promise on the beach

scenes.title: {wife.first} does not like {capo.first}
scenes.text: "He kicked the Lombardi boy's dog," {wife.first} says, buttering toast she will not eat. "In the street. In front of the children." She means {capo.call}. She has never asked you for anything about the business. She is asking now.

opinion.why: Listened to me about that animal
Lets his wife tell him about his men
Went to her husband about me
Told me to stay out of it

memory.text: he chose that animal over her

choices.label: Send the Lombardis a new puppy, and a check

opinion.why: Made it right with the Lombardis

scenes.title: A note from the Sisters
scenes.text: Sister Mary Agnes writes in a hand like barbed wire: {kid.first} has been running a dice game behind the gymnasium at St. Ann's, and running it well. {kid.He} gives the other children credit at ten percent. She would like a word with the parents.

choices.label: Go see the Sister, hat in hand

family.why: The boss went to the school himself

opinion.why: Came to the school for me

choices.label: Laugh, then take the dice away
See to {kid.his} education properly
choices.hint: A tutor from among your people.
